Maya S.: FYI — QubeHealth renewal is stuck: DocuSign bounced with a card decline, customer wants to pay by credit card to get seats unlocked before Monday go-live. Can we accept CC for $72k? :grimacing:
Priya K.: Heads up — finance prefers wire for >$50k. Card adds ~3% fee. We can accept if they cover the fee or we get explicit approval from Amy. Amount is $72,000 for a 12mo term, right?
Maya S.: Yep $72,000. Customer says they can cover the cc fee if needed — they need access on Mon to finish onboarding. They also tried to resend DocuSign but got an "envelope failed to send" error. Error snippet: ```Error: envelope_send_failed - recipient email rejected by gateway```
Carlos L.: Legal note — if we accept CC payment, we still need signed SOW with billing entity and PO attached. Make sure the e-sign envelope includes the billing contact role and the GDPR/data processing clause. If they supply a PO + signed SOW we can proceed.
Ben R.: Is there a way for CS Ops to send a hosted one-time payment link (Stripe invoice) to expedite? That avoids re-sending DocuSign until legal confirms.
Priya K.: Finance can generate a Stripe invoice/hosted pay link, but Amy must approve card acceptance for this size. If not approved, we need wire instructions and that will delay activation.
Maya S.: Looping Amy — @Amy F. can we get an exception to accept CC if customer covers the fee and provides PO, VAT, and signed SOW? They'll pay immediately once link is live.
Amy F.: OK as a one-off if customer covers 3% card fee and we get PO + signed SOW. Finance needs GL codes and the billing entity name. Also require VAT number for EU tax handling.
Maya S.: Got it — I'll request PO and VAT. Customer already provided VAT: "QH-EU-12345". I'll resend DocuSign with updated signer email + attach PO. If they still prefer card, I'll send Stripe pay link and note the fee.
Carlos L.: When you resend the envelope, include this clause in the additional text: "Payment method accepted: credit card or wire; if credit card is used, a 3% processing fee applies unless otherwise agreed in writing." That covers us.
Maya S.: Will include. Also setting a canary plan: if DocuSign fails again, we send the Stripe invoice and cc Amy + Finance.
amity-bot: Renewal QubeHealth assigned to Maya S. — due 2026-03-22.
Priya K.: Once payment clears (card or wire) finance will mark invoice paid and ops can provision seats immediately. Please ping with transaction id.
Maya S.: Ping — resending DocuSign now to new signer (ops@qubehealth.io). If it fails, I'll create Stripe invoice and request immediate payment.
Carlos L.: +1 to the contingency. Also confirm the signer is authorized to accept billing terms (ask for name and title).
Maya S.: Confirmed signer is "Jordan Lee, Head of Ops" — emailed PO just now. Customer said they'll cover fee if necessary. I'll update thread when payment confirmed.
Priya K.: Finance note — once we have PO + VAT + payment we can process the recognition and send receipts.
Maya S.: Thanks team. Moving to action: resend DocuSign, attach PO and clause, prepare Stripe invoice as backup. Will update when payment clears. :white_check_mark:
